name: Middlesbrough
sourceReview: Middlesbrough Council's official page evidences a local land-charges registry/procedure and council GIS mapping-data request route. HM Land Registry is the national England-and-Wales land-registration custodian and its first-party INSPIRE service lists a Middlesbrough Borough Council GML partition. No public local parcel API was evidenced.
